segments.text: The ford first. I have too few guards to bury another.
segments.speaker: dagna_holt

segments.text: The bridge cost us enough. Now a grey bear takes goats from the pens. The boy got out; Maud has him by her fire. The cave mouth is below her hut on the burned bank. Will you put an end to this?

segments.text: Bring the ember-claw back. Sixty gold and a fitted trinket each. I will keep gifts for anyone away. Go carefully; that bear has lived through more winters than this Watch.

segments.text: Still warm. Tobin can work with this. Your gold is counted, and there is a rare trinket fitted to each of your callings. Accepting replaces any trinket you already wear. Shall I present them?
